editorial.blurb: Chicago's only Nikkei hand roll bar seamlessly weaves Japanese technique with Peruvian flavor, delivering memorable courses crafted right before you at the bar.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive at the sushi bar to watch the chef hand-roll each piece in front of you—ask Michael for recommendations, and order the unagi nigiri with dark chocolate and candied ginger as a savory-dessert hybrid.
signatureDishes: Unagi Nigiri with Candied Ginger, Dark Chocolate and Salt

topDishes.note: Absolutely mind-blowing, a standout among all hand rolls
